q1.explanationZh: 第一段结尾说这是全世界数百万人都有的常见问题，所以回答 Yes。

evidence.quote: It’s a common problem shared by millions of people around the world.

q2.sampleAnswer: Feelings of pain when eating or drinking something cold, hot, sweet or sour, or when taking a deep breath of cold air.

keyPoints.descZh: 吃喝冷、热、甜、酸的东西时感到疼痛，或吸冷空气时疼
examples: feelings of pain when they eat or drink something cold, hot, sweet or sour

q2.rubricZh: 要点：吃喝冷、热、甜、酸的东西或吸入冷空气时会疼。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说敏感牙齿的人吃喝冷热酸甜的东西时会有疼痛感，吸一口冷空气也可能疼。

evidence.quote: Sometimes even a deep breath of cold air can cause pain.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because it can wear down the enamel on my teeth.
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说刷牙太用力会磨掉牙齿外面的牙釉质，牙齿就变得敏感。

evidence.quote: brushing your teeth too hard can wear down the

q4.rubricZh: 要点：苏打饮料、番茄（各1分）。
q4.explanationZh: 第三段在 acidic 后面举了两个例子：汽水和番茄。

q5.sampleAnswer: I can use a soft toothbrush and brush my teeth carefully and gently. I can also watch what I eat and drink.

keyPoints.descZh: 用软牙刷、仔细轻柔地刷牙
examples: use a soft toothbrush and brush carefully and gently
watch what I eat and drink

q5.rubricZh: 要点：用软牙刷、轻柔仔细地刷牙；注意饮食。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段给了两个办法：用软牙刷并轻轻仔细地刷牙，还要注意吃什么喝什么。

evidence.quote: Using a soft toothbrush and brushing your teeth carefully and gently will help.

q6.sampleAnswer: Because having good teeth enables us to eat well and stay healthy. It’ll save us from pain and we don’t have to spend money or time going to the dentist’s. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

examples: We can eat well and stay healthy.
We don’t have to spend money going to the dentist.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，合理即可，至少两点：能吃好、保持健康；免于疼痛；省钱省时间。
q6.explanationZh: 好牙齿让我们吃得好、身体好，还能避免疼痛，也不用花钱花时间去看牙医。言之有理即可。

evidence.quote: People with sensitive teeth may experience feelings of pain when they eat or drink

q7.explanationZh: 第一空缺动词过去式，share … with 意为“分享”，与 He 搭配用过去式 shared。

q8.explanationZh: take a deep breath 是“深呼吸”，空格需要名词 breath。

q9.explanationZh: The price is reduced from…to… 表示价格被降低，用被动语态 reduced。

q10.explanationZh: bed was so 后面要形容词，“不舒服的”是 uncomfortable。

q11.explanationZh: had dinner and watched TV，两个动作并列，都用过去式 watched。

q12.explanationZh: the most common cause 意为“最常见的原因”。

q13.explanationZh: 原句 It’s 是 It is，改一般疑问句把 is 提到句首，主语 it 放后面：Is it a common problem…?

q14.explanationZh: 画线部分是 Scientists 发现的内容，用 what 提问，时态是现在完成时，所以用 What have scientists found?

q15.explanationZh: 原句是一般将来时 will help，否定句是 will not help，缩写为 won’t help。

q16.explanationZh: 否定句用 can’t，句末 too 在否定句中要改成 either。
q16.tipsZh: too 用于肯定句，either 用于否定句

q17.explanationZh: Brushing your teeth carefully and gently 作主语，will help reduce the pain 作谓语，over time（久而久之）放在句末。
q17.tipsZh: help (to) do sth. 帮助做某事
